source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
Your army gains:

- 1 extra use of the **devastator doctrine** per battle.
- +1 **S** for ranged attacks by friendly **ADEPTUS ASTARTES** units against a unit within 12".

With a **VULKAN HE’STAN** unit in your army, your **INFERNUS SQUAD** units also gain:

- **[Advance](vsdata:core-rule/advance-move)** and **[Fall Back moves](vsdata:core-rule/fall-back)** do not make the unit ineligible to **start an action**.
- Starting an **action** does not make the unit ineligible to shoot.

**Restrictions:** no **ADEPTUS ASTARTES** units from another Chapter; **SALAMANDERS** units are allowed.

combat.unresolved: Withheld as a class: the last two independent reviews found 8 of 296 combat readings of Detachment rules (every record of the class not withheld otherwise, each time) wrong or partly wrong, not under the 2% this reading may ship with.

infernus.requires: your army includes a Vulkan He’stan unit
